content.title: Live results: Alycia Baumgardner beats Bo Mi Re Shin to retain titles - Video - FIGHTMAG
content.text: April 18, 2026 1:28 AM EDT Alycia Baumgardner defeats Bo Mi Re Shin by decision to retain titles Alycia Baumgardner (18-1, 7 KOs) defeats Bo Mi Re Shin (19-4-3, 10 KOs) by unanimous decision to retain her unified IBF, WBA, and WBO super featherweight titles. The judges scored the fight 98-92, 98-92, and 99-91. Alycia Baumgardner poses with her championship belts after her victory over Bo Mi Re Shin at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City, NY, on April 17, 2026. Photo by Michelle Farsi / Most Valuable Promotions April 18, 2026 12:53 AM EDT Watch: Alycia Baumgardner Ring Walk Alycia Baumgardner makes her ring walk for her unified title defense against Bo Mi Re Shin. April 18, 2026 12:42 AM EDT Lani Daniels stops Shadasia Green to win world titles Lani Daniels (12-4-2, 1 KO) defeats Shadasia Green (16-2, 11 KOs) by ninth-round TKO to become the new IBF and WBO super middleweight champion. The referee stepped in at 0:32 of the round. April 17, 2026 11:40 PM EDT Krystal Rosado defeats Fernanda Reyes by decision Krystal Rosado (9-1, 2 KOs) defeats Fernanda Reyes (8-1) by unanimous decision at bantamweight. The judges scored the fight 79-73, 80-72, and 78-74. April 17, 2026 11:03 PM EDT Alycia Baumgardner In The Building Alycia Baumgardner has arrived at the Infosys Theater at MSG in New York to face Bo Mi Re Shin. April 17, 2026 11:01 PM EDT Natalie Dove defeats Maria Micheo by decision Natalie Dove (8-0-1, 2 KOs) defeats Maria Micheo (14-7, 8 KOs) by split decision at flyweight. The judges scored the fight 77-75, 75-77, and 77-75. April 17, 2026 9:55 PM EDT Jahmal Harvey stops Daniel Lugo in fifth round Jahmal Harvey (3-0, 2 KOs) defeats Daniel Lugo (6-5, 2 KOs) by fifth-round TKO at lightweight. The stoppage came at 1:32 of the round. April 17, 2026 9:23 PM EDT Alex Vargas defeats Rani Jalomo by decision Alex Vargas (15-0, 5 KOs) defeats Rani Jalomo (7-1-1, 4 KOs) by unanimous decision at super lightweight. The judges scored the fight 78-74, 78-74, and 79-73. April 17, 2026 8:39 PM EDT Elon De Jesus defeats Connor Adaway by decision Elon De Jesus (12-1-2, 8 KOs) defeats Connor Adaway (10-3-1, 4 KOs) by unanimous decision at super bantamweight. The judges scored the fight 80-71, 78-73, and 78-73. April 17, 2026 7:42 PM EDT Luis Gjolena KOs Robert Salinas in second round Luis Gjolena (8-0-1, 6 KOs) defeats Robert Salinas (4-3-1, 3 KOs) by second-round knockout at heavyweight. April 17, 2026 7:20 PM EDT Raquel Miller outpoints Adriana Araujo to stay unbeaten Raquel Miller (14-0, 6 KOs) defeats Adriana Araujo (6-4, 1 KO) by unanimous decision at super middleweight. The judges scored the fight 58-55, 57-56, and 57-56. April 17, 2026 6:02 PM EDT Baumgardner vs Shin – Kick Off Not long now until the boxing action at the Infosys Theater at MSG begins. April 17, 2026 4:52 PM EDT Baumgardner, Shin make weight ahead of 130-pound title clash At the weigh-in conducted a day before the event, both fighters successfully made the required 130-pound championship limit. Alycia Baumgardner came in at 129.8 lbs, while Bo Mi Re Shin showed 129.4 lbs. Alycia Baumgardner and Bo Mi Re Shin during the weigh-in at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York City, NY, on April 16, 2026. Photo by Michelle Farsi/Most Valuable Promotions April 17, 2026 3:53 PM EDT Video: Alycia Baumgardner vs Leila Beaudoin In case you missed it, watch the highlights from Alycia Baumgardner’s previous fight last December, where she faced and defeated Leila Beaudoin to retain her titles, live on Netflix. April 17, 2026 12:00 AM EDT How to watch and start time Baumgardner vs. Shin airs live on ESPN at 10:00 p.m. ET / 7:00 p.m. PT, following the prelims on ESPN+ at 6:45 p.m. ET / 3:45 p.m. PT. L-R: Shadasia Green, Alycia Baumgardner, Bo Mi Re Shin, and Lani Daniels during the press conference at Palladium Times Square in New York City, NY, on April 15, 2026. Photo by Michelle Farsi / Most Valuable Promotions
